networks.label: Grand Paris Seine & Oise
networks.notes: Exact PAN contracting-authority scope inside the generic Alize Liberte brand. Canonical audit validates 160 stations / 327 PDC, all rankable on the direct QR/app/partner-badge tariff, with a separate non-rankable contactless-bank-card reference and zero physical-inventory mutation.

networks.label: C-Park Rennes
networks.notes: Exact CITEDIA METROPOLE scope inside Alize Liberte. Canonical audit run 33459127114 validates 8 Rennes parking stations / 233 PAN PDC, all covered on the Alize direct tariff, with 233 separate non-rankable third-party references, zero unresolved and zero physical-inventory mutation.

networks.label: Griffon Branché
networks.notes: Exact Saint-Brieuc scope inside R-Mob / Alize Liberte. Corrected canonical audit run 33495031487 validates 16 official sites, 48 official user-facing charge points represented by 74 PAN connector/PDC rows; all 74 PAN rows covered, 74 public plus 74 opt-in subscriber offers, family split 22 AC / 12 DC 30 kW / 40 Express rows, zero unresolved and zero physical-inventory mutation. The 74 PAN rows must never be presented as 74 official physical charge points.

networks.label: Ville de Dreux
networks.notes: Corrected canonical audit run 33497175035 validates the exact R-Mob / Alize Liberte local scope in INSEE 28134: 11 PAN stations / 45 connector-PDC rows, all 45 covered by public and opt-in subscriber offers, zero unresolved and zero physical-inventory mutation. The official network page lists 12 sites / 24 user-facing charge points; PAN remains the sole physical inventory and the missing twelfth site is never synthesized.

networks.label: Ville d'Arcachon
networks.notes: Exact R-Mob / Alize Liberte local scope in INSEE 33009. Official topology is 19 sites / 68 user-facing charge points; current PAN is expected to represent the same sites with connector-level PDC granularity. Resident subscription remains opt-in and residency-gated.
